abstract:
BACKGROUND: Clinical and molecular features of pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC) according to involved metastatic sites have not been well characterized.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: We used the Foundry platform to query information for patients with metastatic PDAC at MD Anderson Cancer Center. Involved metastatic sites were extracted using natural language processing from imaging reports and verified by chart reviews. Overall survival (OS) and next generation sequencing (NGS) data were analyzed.
RESULTS: In a cohort of 1,095 patients (median overall survival [OS]: 22.8 months), lung-only metastasis was associated with longer median OS (57.6 months, p<0.0001). Patients with metastases not involving the liver had OS of 41.3 months, while liver-only (19.5 months) and multiple sites including liver (19.3 months) had the poorest survival. TP53 mutation rates were higher in liver-involved groups (84-85%) versus lung-only (73%) and non-liver metastases (67%, p<0.0001). Lower rates of GNAS mutations were detected in liver-only (5%) and liver-involved (2%) cases, higher in lung-only (8%) and non-liver (10%, p<0.01). The frequency of KRAS mutation and mutant allele distribution were not significantly different in tissue based NGS. However, in liquid biopsy analysis (n = 240), lung-only metastasis showed the lowest mutation detection (50%), TP53 (23%) and KRAS (10%), compared to liver-only detection rates of 65%, 46%, and 52% respectively (p values: 0.009, 0.02, <0.001).
CONCLUSIONS: Patients with PDAC without liver metastasis have significantly improved OS and lower rates of TP53 mutation. Patients with lung-only metastasis had longer OS, a lower liquid-biopsy positivity rate, and a lower rate of KRAS detection by liquid biopsy; because liquid biopsy may under-detect KRAS in lung-only disease, tumor-tissue sequencing should be prioritized in these patients as KRAS-directed therapies emerge.
key_points_ko: 전체 환자 1,095명 중 폐 단독 전이 환자의 중앙 전체 생존기간(OS)은 57.6개월로 간 전이 동반군(19.3~19.5개월) 대비 현저히 길었습니다.
TP53 유전자 변이율은 간 전이가 있는 환자군(84~85%)이 폐 단독(73%) 또는 간 미침범군(67%)보다 높았습니다(p<0.0001).
액체 생검(liquid biopsy, 240명) 분석 시 폐 단독 전이군은 KRAS 변이 검출률이 10%에 불과하여 간 단독 전이군(52%)보다 크게 낮았습니다(p<0.001).
summary_ko: MD 앤더슨 암센터에서 전이성 췌관선암(PDAC) 환자 1,095명을 대상으로 전이 부위에 따른 생존기간과 차세대 염기서열 분석(NGS) 결과를 조사했습니다. 폐에만 전이된 환자의 중앙 전체 생존기간(OS)은 57.6개월로, 간 전이가 있는 환자(약 19.3~19.5개월)보다 유의하게 길었습니다. 간 전이가 동반된 환자군에서는 TP53 변이 비율이 높게 나타났습니다. 폐 전이만 있는 환자는 혈액을 이용한 액체 생검에서 KRAS 변이 검출률이 10%로 매우 낮았으므로, 정확한 유전자 검사를 위해 조직 기반 검사가 우선 권장됩니다.
title: Site-Specific Outcomes and Genomics in Metastatic Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
title_ko: 전이성 췌관선암에서 전이 부위별 예후 및 유전체 특성 분석
